subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining parts of #97971 should become canonical follow-ups after excluding the behavior current main already covers?
rationale: The remaining work crosses public docs, update output, auth/SecretRef guidance, and audit semantics; automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary or whether to expand core audit scope.

options.title: Split docs, update diff, and audit scope
options.body: Create or link focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff reporting, and broader audit semantics while leaving already-implemented CLI/token behavior alone.

options.title: Keep only existing canonical overlaps
options.body: Close or redirect the already-covered portions and point update safety work to existing safe-update and doctor-diff issues without opening new audit scope.

options.title: Decline broad self-healing audit
options.body: Keep the current metadata-only audit and config-write audit surfaces, and document that cron/script snapshots remain operator-owned outside core.

recommendation.title: Split docs, update diff, and audit scope
recommendation.body: Create or link focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff reporting, and broader audit semantics while leaving already-implemented CLI/token behavior alone.

likelyOwner.reason: The largest remaining product choice is whether and how to expand the audit surface that steipete recently introduced on main.
